section.content: 本发明提供了一种锂离子电池，其包括正极极片、负极极片、隔离膜以及电解液。正极极片包括正极集流体以及设置于正极集流体表面且含有正极活性材料的正极膜片，其中，正极活性材料包括基体、以离散的岛状形态包覆在基体表面的第一包覆层以及以连续的层状形态包覆在第一包覆层以及基体表面的第二包覆层。电解液包括添加剂A以及添加剂B，添加剂A选自式1、式2所示的环状磺酸内酯化合物中的一种或几种，添加剂B选自二氟双草酸磷酸锂、四氟草酸磷酸锂中的一种或两种。本发明能降低锂离子电池的产气量，并显著抑制锂离子电池循环和存储过程中直流内阻的增长。

The invention provides a lithium ion battery which comprises a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece, an isolating membrane and electrolyte. The positive pole piece comprises a positive pole current collector and a positive pole membrane which is arranged on the surface of the positive pole current collector and contains a positive pole active material, wherein the positive pole active material comprises a substrate, a first coating layer and a second coating layer, the first coating layer is coated on the surface of the substrate in a discrete island-shaped form, and the second coating layer is coated on the surfaces of the first coating layer and the substrate in a continuous layer-shaped form. The electrolyte comprises an additive A and an additive B, wherein the additive A is selected from one or more of cyclic sultone compounds shown in formulas 1 and 2, and the additive B is selected from one or two of lithium difluorobis (oxalato) phosphate and lithium tetrafluoro (oxalato) phosphate. The invention can reduce the gas production of the lithium ion battery and obviously inhibit the increase of direct current internal resistance in the circulation and storage processes of the lithium ion battery.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery.

Background

The lithium ion battery has the characteristics of high energy density, long cycle life, no pollution and the like, so that the lithium ion battery has wide application prospects in the fields of consumer electronics, power automobile batteries, energy storage power supplies and the like. In any application field, people have higher requirements on the endurance of the lithium ion battery. In order to increase the energy density of lithium ion batteries, it is one of effective approaches to develop a positive active material having a high specific capacity.

At present, the lithium nickel cobalt manganese ternary material becomes a hot point of research due to higher theoretical specific capacity and safety characteristic, however, nickel metal in the lithium nickel cobalt manganese ternary materialThe high content of the transition metal causes the electrolyte to have strong oxidizability, so that the electrolyte is easy to generate electrochemical oxidation reaction on the surface of the positive electrode, and simultaneously causes the structure change of the lithium nickel cobalt manganese ternary material, and the transition metal such as nickel, cobalt and the like is dissolved out by reduction reaction, so that the electrochemical performance of the lithium ion battery is deteriorated, and particularly the high-temperature performance is obviously deteriorated. In addition, excessive lithium salt can be added in the preparation process of the lithium-nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material to compensate lithium loss caused in the sintering process, so that a small amount of Li remains on the surface of the prepared cathode active material, and Li can be used as Li at high temperature2In the form of O, Li after the temperature has dropped to room temperature2O can adsorb CO in the air2And H2O to form LiOH and Li2CO3And the existence of residual lithium can aggravate gas generation of the lithium ion battery and deteriorate storage performance. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese ternary material is usually in a secondary particle form formed by agglomeration of primary particles, the compressive strength is poor, the specific surface area of the crushed positive active material is remarkably increased, the contact area with an electrolyte is increased, and the gas generation problem of the lithium ion battery is further worsened.

Therefore, how to effectively inhibit the oxidative decomposition of the lithium-nickel-cobalt-manganese ternary material on the electrolyte and reduce the content of residual lithium on the surface of the electrolyte is the key for improving the high-temperature performance of the lithium ion battery. In the lithium ion battery, 1, 3-Propane Sultone (PS) is usually adopted to reduce the gas production in the high-temperature storage process of the lithium ion battery, but a passivation film formed on the surface of a positive electrode by the 1, 3-propane sultone is not durable enough, so that the passivation film is continuously oxidized and decomposed in the circulation and storage processes of the lithium ion battery, the direct current internal resistance of the lithium ion battery in the circulation and storage processes is continuously increased, the acceleration performance and the power performance of the lithium ion battery are poor, and the use of the lithium ion battery is seriously influenced.

Disclosure of Invention

In view of the problems in the background art, it is an object of the present invention to provide a lithium ion battery that can reduce the gas production of the lithium ion battery and significantly suppress the increase in the direct current internal resistance during the cycling and storage of the lithium ion battery.

In order to achieve the above object, the present invention provides a methodThe lithium ion battery comprises a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece, an isolating membrane and electrolyte, wherein the isolating membrane is arranged between the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece. The positive pole piece comprises a positive pole current collector and a positive pole membrane which is arranged on the surface of the positive pole current collector and contains a positive pole active material, wherein the positive pole active material comprises a substrate, a first coating layer and a second coating layer, the first coating layer is coated on the surface of the substrate in a discrete island-shaped form, and the second coating layer is coated on the surfaces of the first coating layer and the substrate in a continuous layer-shaped form. The general formula of the matrix is LixNiyCozMkMepOrAmX is more than or equal to 0.95 and less than or equal to 1.05, Y is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1, z is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1, k is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1, Y + z + k + p is equal to 1, r is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 2, M is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 2, M is selected from one or two of Mn and Al, Me is selected from one or more of Zr, Zn, Cu, Cr, Mg, Fe, V, Ti, Y and Nb, and A is selected from one or more of N, F, S, Cl. The general formula of the matrix is LixNiyCozMkMepOrAmX is more than or equal to 0.95 and less than or equal to 1.05, Y is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1, z is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1, k is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1, Y + z + k + p is equal to 1, r is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 2, M is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 2, M is selected from one or two of Mn and Al, Me is selected from one or more of Zr, Zn, Cu, Cr, Mg, Fe, V, Ti, Y and Nb, and A is selected from one or more of N, F, S, Cl. The first coating layer is an oxide containing metal N, and N is selected from one or more of Al, Zr, Mg, Ti, Co, Y, Ba and Cd. The second coating layer is an oxide containing an element N ', and N' is selected from one or more of B, Sn, S and P. The electrolyte comprises a lithium salt and an organic solvent, and further comprises an additive A and an additive B. The additive A is selected from one or more of cyclic sultone compounds shown in formula 1 and formula 2, in formula 1, R is selected from substituted or unsubstituted straight-chain alkylene with 3-8 carbon atoms, and substituent groups are selected from one or more of alkyl with 1-6 carbon atoms and halogen atoms; the additive B is selected from one or two of lithium difluorobis (oxalato) phosphate and lithium tetrafluoro (oxalato) phosphate.

Compared with the prior art, the invention at least comprises the following beneficial effects:

in the lithium ion battery, the anode active material can effectively reduce the gas production of the lithium ion battery, and the additive A and the additive B in the electrolyte can be matched to further generate a layer of compact and firm passivation film on the surface of the anode active material, so that the oxidation effect of the passivation film on the electrolyte is weakened, the gas production of the lithium ion battery is further reduced, and the increase of direct current internal resistance in the circulation and storage processes of the lithium ion battery is remarkably inhibited.

Drawings

Fig. 1 and 2 are SEM images of the positive electrode active material obtained in example 1 of the present invention, in which fig. 1 is at a magnification of 50000 times and fig. 2 is at a magnification of 5000 times.

Detailed Description

The lithium ion battery according to the present invention is explained in detail below.

The lithium ion battery comprises a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece, an isolating membrane and electrolyte, wherein the isolating membrane is arranged between the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece.

In the lithium ion battery of the invention, the positive pole piece comprises a positive pole current collector and a positive pole diaphragm which is arranged on the surface of the positive pole current collector and contains a positive pole active material. The positive electrode active material comprises a substrate, a first coating layer and a second coating layer, wherein the first coating layer is coated on the surface of the substrate in a discrete island-shaped mode, and the second coating layer is coated on the surfaces of the first coating layer and the substrate in a continuous layer-shaped mode. The general formula of the matrix is LixNiyCozMkMepOrAmX is more than or equal to 0.95 and less than or equal to 1.05, Y is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1, z is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1, k is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1, p is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 0.1, Y + z + k + p is equal to 1, r is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 2, M is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 2, M is selected from one or two of Mn and Al, Me is selected from one or more of Zr, Zn, Cu, Cr, Mg, FeF, S, Cl. The first coating layer is an oxide containing metal N, and N is selected from one or more of Al, Zr, Mg, Ti, Co, Y, Ba and Cd. The second coating layer is an oxide containing an element N ', and N' is selected from one or more of B, Sn, S and P.

In the lithium ion battery, the positive active material has the characteristic of low content of residual lithium on the surface, so that the gas generation caused by the residual lithium can be effectively reduced; the surface of the matrix of the positive active material is provided with two coating layers, so that the positive active material also has the characteristic of high surface structure stability, can effectively avoid the direct contact of the matrix and the electrolyte, reduce the side reaction of the matrix and the electrolyte, and avoid the generation of a large amount of gas caused by the side reaction of the matrix and the electrolyte; the second coating layer can be uniformly coated on the surfaces of the base body and the first coating layer, and the second coating layer is compact and continuous in layered form, so that the roughness of the surface of the positive active material can be effectively reduced, the specific surface area of the positive active material is reduced, the effective contact area of the surface of the positive active material and electrolyte is further reduced, the side reaction of the surface of the positive active material and the electrolyte is reduced, and the generation of a large amount of gas due to the side reaction of the surface of the positive active material and the electrolyte is avoided. Therefore, the anode active material can effectively reduce the gas production rate of the lithium ion battery and improve the storage gas production performance of the lithium ion battery.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the matrix of the positive electrode active material may be in the form of secondary particles formed by agglomeration of primary particles.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the first coating layer and the second coating layer may be located at surface positions of the primary particles of the matrix of the positive electrode active material. Preferably, the first coating layer and the second coating layer may be located on the surface of the primary particles constituting the outermost layer of the matrix in the form of the secondary particles. Further preferably, the first coating layer and the second coating layer may be located on the surface of the primary particles constituting the outermost layer of the matrix in the form of the secondary particles and at least a part of the inner primary particles (i.e., the primary particles located at a position other than the outermost layer of the matrix).

In the lithium ion battery, the first coating layer is in a discrete island shape, and the second coating layer is in a continuous layer shape, so that the first coating layer in the discrete island shape can play a role similar to a 'nano nail' on the surface of the primary particles of the substrate, the first coating layer can be firmly combined with the substrate, the probability of breaking the positive active material particles in the circulation process is effectively reduced, and meanwhile, the first coating layer in the discrete island shape can also enhance the binding force between the primary particles of the substrate and the primary particles, so that the overall mechanical strength of the positive active material (especially in the form of secondary particles formed by agglomeration of the primary particles) is increased, and the positive active material is not easy to break.

Referring to fig. 3, which is a schematic structural view of the cathode active material of the present invention, wherein the second coating layer is not shown, the matrix of the cathode active material is in the form of secondary particles (agglomerates) formed by agglomeration of primary particles, so that a portion of the metal N-containing oxide located between the primary particles may function to bind the primary particles to the primary particles. Fig. 3 is a schematic view only, and shows that the metal N-containing oxide can bind the primary particles to the primary particles, but the metal N-containing oxide can also be located at other positions on the surface of the primary particles, and can function like "nano-pins".

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the particle diameter D50 of the matrix of the positive electrode active material may be 5 to 25 μm, and preferably, the particle diameter D50 of the matrix of the positive electrode active material may be 8 to 18 μm.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the specific surface area of the positive electrode active material is 0.3m2/g～0.8m2/g。

In the lithium ion battery, the content of the metal N in the first coating layer is 0.05-1% of the mass of the matrix.

In the lithium ion battery, the content of the element N' in the second coating layer is 0.05-0.8% of the mass of the matrix.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the first coating layer may further contain Li, i.e. the first coating layer may be an oxide of one or more elements of Al, Zr, Mg, Ti, Co, Y, Ba, Cd, or the first coating layer may also be Al, Zr, Mg, Ti, Co, Y, Ba, Cd,Oxide of one or more elements of Cd and Li2O, and solid solution of oxides.

In the lithium ion battery of the invention, the second coating layer may further contain Li, that is, the second coating layer may be an oxide of one or more elements of B, Sn, S, and P, or the second coating layer may also be an oxide of one or more elements of B, Sn, S, and P and Li2O, and solid solution of oxides.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, preferably, in the matrix of the positive electrode active material, 0.70. ltoreq. y.ltoreq.0.95, 0. ltoreq. z.ltoreq.0.2, 0. ltoreq. k.ltoreq.0.2, 0. ltoreq. p.ltoreq.0.05, and y + z + k + p 1. Further preferably, the matrix of the positive electrode active material may be selected from LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2、LiNi0.70Co0.15Mn0.15O2、LiNi0.95Co0.02Mn0.03O2、LiNi0.8Co0.1Al0.1O2、LiNi0.70Co0.15Mn0.15O1.8F0.2、LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.08Zr0.02O2、LiNi0.75Co0.15Mn0.05Nb0.05O2One or more of them.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, Li on the surface of the positive electrode active material2CO3The content is 300ppm to 3000ppm, and the LiOH content on the surface of the positive electrode active material is 1500ppm to 5000 ppm.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the content of LiOH in the residual lithium on the surface of the positive electrode active material is higher than that of Li2CO3And (4) content.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the positive electrode film further includes a binder and a conductive agent. The specific types of the binder and the conductive agent are not particularly limited and may be selected as desired.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the specific type of the positive electrode current collector is not particularly limited and may be selected as desired. Preferably, the positive electrode collector may be an aluminum foil.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the method for preparing the positive active material may include the steps of: s1, adding the metal N oxide nano particles into deionized water, stirring and carrying out ultrasonic oscillation to obtain a uniformly dispersed metal N oxide aqueous solution; s2, mixing Li as matrix of positive active materialxNiyCozMkMepOrAmAdding the mixture into a metal N oxide aqueous solution, stirring to dissolve residual lithium on the surface of a matrix into water, attaching metal N oxide nanoparticles to the surface of the matrix, and then filtering and drying to remove the solvent to obtain powder; s3, mixing the powder obtained in the step S2 with the simple substance or the compound containing the element N', and then carrying out heat treatment to obtain the anode active material.

In the preparation method of the anode active material, the matrix is washed by water and is directly coated for the first time, so that the first coating layer can be firmly combined with the matrix, the probability of breaking anode active material particles in the circulation process is effectively reduced, meanwhile, the second coating layer can be uniformly coated after heat treatment, the roughness of the surface of the anode active material can be effectively reduced, the specific surface area of the anode active material is reduced, the effective contact area of the surface of the anode active material and electrolyte is further reduced, the side reaction of the surface of the anode active material and the electrolyte is reduced, and the gas production rate of the lithium ion battery is reduced.

In the method for preparing the positive electrode active material, further, after the drying process of step S2, the metal N oxide nanoparticles exist in discrete island-like shapes on the surface of the substrate, so that they act like "nano-nails" on the surface of the primary particles of the substrate, and after the heat treatment sintering process of step S3, the bonding of the primary coating layer formed of the metal N oxide nanoparticles to the substrate becomes stronger, and the bonding force between the primary particles and the primary particles in the substrate can be enhanced by eutectic bonding of the metal N oxide nanoparticles on the surface of the primary particles, so that the overall mechanical strength of the positive electrode active material (especially in the form of secondary particles formed by agglomeration of the primary particles) is increased, and the positive electrode active material is not easily broken.

In the method for preparing the positive electrode active material, after the first coating layer and the second coating layer are compounded on the surface of the substrate of the positive electrode active material through the heat treatment process of the step S3, the first coating layer still maintains the discrete island-shaped form. That is, after the drying process of step S2, the metal N-oxide nanoparticles can be bonded to the substrate and coated on the surface of the substrate, and after the heat treatment process of step S3, the bonding between the metal N-oxide nanoparticles and the substrate becomes stronger, and the first coating layer and the second coating layer are completely combined on the surface of the substrate. However, the morphology of the metal N-oxide nanoparticles (or the first coating layer) is not changed fundamentally in the heat treatment process of step S3, for example, a small amount of melting may occur, but the morphology of the first coating layer as a whole is still discrete island-like morphology with protrusions and does not form a continuous layered morphology.

In the method of producing the positive electrode active material, the particle diameter of the metal N oxide nanoparticles in step S1 is not more than 100 nm. Preferably, the metal N-oxide nanoparticles have a particle size of 5nm to 10 nm.

In the method for producing the positive electrode active material, in step S2, residual lithium LiOH and Li on the surface of the substrate2CO3Can be dissolved in water; the metal N oxide nanoparticles in the aqueous solution can be adsorbed on the surface of primary particles of the matrix to finally form a first coating layer in a discrete island shape due to small particle size, so that the probability of crushing the positive active material particles in the circulating process is effectively reduced; meanwhile, after the heat treatment sintering process of step S3, the metal N oxide nanoparticles partially adsorbed at the contact positions between the primary particles of the matrix and the primary particles can be bonded to the primary particles by eutectic melting, so that the mechanical strength of the whole positive electrode active material is increased and the positive electrode active material is not easily broken. When the matrix of the positive electrode active material is in the form of secondary particles formed by agglomeration of primary particles, the metal N-oxide nanoparticles may also be adsorbed on the surface of the primary particles inside at least a portion of the matrix (i.e., the primary particles located at a position other than the outermost layer of the matrix), and may eventually form a first coating layer in the form of discrete islands.

In the method for preparing the positive active material, the drying temperature in step S2 is 80 to 150 ℃.

In the method for producing the positive electrode active material, the simple substance or the compound containing the element N' is preferably selected from low-melting-point substances, and further preferably, the low-melting-point substance has a melting point of not higher than 500 ℃.

In the method for preparing the positive electrode active material, preferably, the compound containing the element N' may be B2O3、H3BO3Or P2O5. Sn, S and P can be coated in the form of simple substances, and B is preferably coated in the form of a compound, for example, B2O3、H3BO3The compounds can also be used in the form of P for coating, e.g. P2O5. Wherein, simple substances and compounds (B) of B, Sn, S and P2O3、H3BO3Or P2O5) Has a low melting point and can be melted at a low temperature, so that during the heat treatment, these simple substances and compounds can form a coating layer (i.e., a second coating layer) in a dense and continuous layer-like form on the surfaces of the primary particles constituting the outermost layer of the matrix in the form of secondary particles and at least a part of the inner primary particles (i.e., the primary particles located at the non-outermost position of the matrix), these simple substances and compounds may form a dense and continuous second coating layer in a layered form only on the surface of the primary particles constituting the outermost layer of the matrix in the form of secondary particles, thereby effectively reducing the surface roughness of the anode active material and the specific surface area of the anode active material, further reducing the effective contact area between the surface of the positive active material and the electrolyte, reducing the side reaction between the surface of the positive active material and the electrolyte, and reducing the gas production of the lithium ion battery.

In the method for preparing the positive electrode active material, the heat treatment temperature is 150 ℃ to 500 ℃ in step S3, and at a lower heat treatment temperature, the first coating layer in the form of discrete islands on the surface of the substrate and the substrate can be firmly bonded, and the second coating layer in the form of a dense and continuous layer can be continuously and uniformly coated on the surface of the substrate and the first coating layer. In addition, the lower heat treatment temperature can avoid the melting-out of bulk lithium in the matrix.

In the lithium ion battery, the negative electrode plate comprises a negative electrode current collector and a negative electrode diaphragm which is arranged on the surface of the negative electrode current collector and contains a negative electrode active material. Wherein the negative active material is selected from metallic lithium, natural graphite, artificial graphite, mesophase micro carbon spheres (MCMB), hard carbon, soft carbon, silicon-carbon composite, SiO, Li-Sn alloy, Li-Sn-O alloy, Sn, SnO2Li of spinel structure4Ti5O12And one or more of Li-Al alloy.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the negative electrode diaphragm further includes a binder and a conductive agent. The specific types of the binder and the conductive agent are not particularly limited and may be selected as desired.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the specific kind of the negative electrode current collector is not particularly limited and may be selected as needed. Preferably, the negative electrode current collector may be a copper foil.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the electrolyte includes a lithium salt and an organic solvent, and the electrolyte further includes an additive a and an additive B.

The additive A is selected from one or more cyclic sultone compounds shown in formula 1 and formula 2, in formula 1, R is selected from substituted or unsubstituted straight-chain alkylene with 3-8 carbon atoms, and substituent groups are selected from one or more alkyl with 1-6 carbon atoms and halogen atoms.

In formula 1, the number of carbon atoms in the linear alkylene group having 3 to 8 carbon atoms is preferably 3 or 4 as the lower limit, and 4, 5, 6, 7 or 8 as the upper limit. Preferably, a linear alkylene group having 3 to 7 carbon atoms is selected; more preferably, a linear alkylene group having 3 to 6 carbon atoms is selected. Specific examples of the linear alkylene group having 3 to 8 carbon atoms include: propylene, butylene, pentylene, hexylene.

In formula 1, when R is selected from a substituted linear alkylene group having 3 to 8 carbon atoms and the substituent is selected from an alkyl group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms (i.e., R is a branched structure), the alkyl group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms may be a linear alkyl group or a cyclic alkyl group, the linear alkyl group may be a linear alkyl group or a branched alkyl group, and hydrogen on the ring of the cyclic alkyl group may be further substituted by an alkyl group. The number of carbon atoms in the alkyl group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms is preferably 1,2 or 3 at the lower limit, and 3, 4, 5 or 6 at the upper limit. Preferably, a chain alkyl group having 1 to 3 carbon atoms is selected. Examples of the alkyl group having 1 to 6 carbon atoms include: methyl, ethyl, n-propyl, isopropyl, n-butyl, isobutyl, sec-butyl, n-pentyl, isopentyl, neopentyl, hexyl, 2-methyl-pentyl, 3-methyl-pentyl, 1, 2-trimethyl-propyl, 3-dimethyl-butyl.

In the formula 1, when R is selected from linear alkylene with 3-8 carbon atoms after being substituted by halogen, the halogen atom can be selected from one or more of fluorine, chlorine, bromine and iodine, and fluorine is preferred.

The additive B is selected from one or two of lithium difluorobis (oxalato) phosphate and lithium tetrafluoro (oxalato) phosphate.

In the lithium ion battery, the cyclic sultone sulfonate compound can be oxidized and decomposed on the surface of the anode to form a protective film, so that the oxidative decomposition of electrolyte on the surface of the anode is effectively reduced, and the high-temperature gas production performance of the battery is further improved. When lithium difluorobis (oxalato) phosphate and/or lithium tetrafluoro (oxalato) phosphate are added into an electrolyte containing a cyclic sultone compound, the oxalate functional group in the structure of the lithium difluorobis (oxalato) phosphate and/or lithium tetrafluoro (oxalato) phosphate can be easily oxidized on the surface of a positive electrode to generate an inorganic lithium salt containing characteristic elements such as P, F and the like, so that a protective film on the surface of the positive electrode is modified, and a P element in the inorganic lithium salt can be combined with lone-pair electrons on oxygen in a positive electrode active material (mainly a matrix) due to the vacancy orbit, so that the oxidation activity of the positive electrode active material is reduced, the continuous oxidative decomposition of the cyclic sultone compound at the positive electrode is inhibited, the increase of direct-current internal resistance in the circulation and storage processes of a lithium ion battery is remarkably inhibited. In addition, the surface of the matrix of the positive active material contains the double-layer coating layer, and the surface structure stability of the positive active material is higher, so that the oxidation activity of the positive active material on the cyclic sultone compound is further reduced, the increase of the interface impedance of the positive electrode can be inhibited to a certain extent, and the power performance of the lithium ion battery is improved.

In the lithium ion battery of the invention, specifically, the additive A is selected from one or more of the following compounds:

in the lithium ion battery, the content of the additive A is 0.1-5% of the total mass of the electrolyte. Preferably, the content of the additive A is 0.3-3% of the total mass of the electrolyte. More preferably, the content of the additive A is 0.5-2% of the total mass of the electrolyte.

In the lithium ion battery, the content of the additive B is 0.01-3% of the total mass of the electrolyte. Preferably, the content of the additive B is 0.1-2% of the total mass of the electrolyte. More preferably, the content of the additive B is 0.2-1% of the total mass of the electrolyte.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the kind of the organic solvent is not particularly limited, and may be selected as needed. Preferably, the organic solvent may be selected from at least two of Ethylene Carbonate (EC), propylene carbonate, butylene carbonate, fluoroethylene carbonate, Ethyl Methyl Carbonate (EMC), dimethyl carbonate, diethyl carbonate (DEC), dipropyl carbonate, methyl propyl carbonate, ethyl propyl carbonate, 1, 4-butyrolactone, methyl propionate, methyl butyrate, ethyl acetate, ethyl propionate, ethyl butyrate, sulfolane, dimethyl sulfone, methyl ethyl sulfone, diethyl sulfone.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the type of the lithium salt is not particularly limited, and may be selected as needed. The lithium salt may be selected from LiPF6、LiBF4、LiClO4、LiAsF6、LiFSI、LiTFSI、LiTFS、LiPO2F2One or more of LiDFOB and LiBOB.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the concentration of the lithium salt is not particularly limited, and may be selected as needed. Preferably, the concentration of the lithium salt may be 0.5mol/L to 1.5 mol/L; further preferably, the concentration of the lithium salt may be 0.8mol/L to 1.2 mol/L.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the electrolyte may further include one or more of Vinylene Carbonate (VC), Vinyl Ethylene Carbonate (VEC), fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC), Succinonitrile (SN), Adiponitrile (ADN), vinyl sulfate (DTD), tris (trimethylsilane) phosphate (TMSP), and tris (trimethylsilane) borate (TMSB).

In the lithium ion battery of the invention, the electrolyte is prepared by a conventional method, for example, all materials in the electrolyte are uniformly mixed. For example, a lithium salt, an additive a, and an additive B are added to an organic solvent and mixed to obtain an electrolyte solution. The order of addition of the materials is not particularly limited. For example, the electrolyte may be obtained by adding the lithium salt to the organic solvent, and then adding and uniformly mixing the additive a and the additive B at the same time.

In the lithium ion battery of the present invention, the specific type of the separator is not particularly limited, and may be selected according to the need, and may be selected, for example, from polyethylene, polypropylene, polyvinylidene fluoride, and a multilayer composite film of the above polyethylene, polypropylene, and polyvinylidene fluoride.

The present application is further illustrated below with reference to examples. It should be understood that these examples are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to limit the scope of the present application. In the following examples, reagents, materials and instruments used are commercially available unless otherwise specified.

For ease of illustration, the additives used in the following examples are abbreviated as follows:

compound 1;a compound 2;compound 3;compound 4;compound 5;compound 6;compound 7;compound 8;compound 9;compound 10.

The lithium ion batteries of examples 1-18 were all prepared as follows.

(1) Preparation of positive electrode active material

Adding metal N oxide nanoparticles (with the particle size of 5-10 nm) and a surfactant into deionized water, stirring and carrying out ultrasonic oscillation to obtain a uniformly dispersed metal N oxide aqueous solution; adding a matrix (with the particle size of 5-25 microns) of the positive active material into a metal N oxide aqueous solution, stirring to dissolve residual lithium on the surface of the matrix in water, attaching metal N oxide nanoparticles to the surface of the matrix, and then filtering and drying to remove deionized water to obtain powder; and mixing the obtained powder with a simple substance or a compound containing the element N', and then carrying out low-temperature heat treatment to obtain the positive active material. The preparation parameters of the positive electrode active material are shown in table 1.

(2) Preparation of positive pole piece

Mixing the positive electrode active material prepared in the step (1), a conductive agent Super P and a binder polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) according to a mass ratio of 97:1.4:1.6, adding the mixture into a solvent N-methyl pyrrolidone (NMP), and uniformly stirring the mixture under the action of a vacuum stirrer to obtain positive electrode slurry, wherein the solid content in the positive electrode slurry is 77 wt%; and uniformly coating the positive electrode slurry on a positive electrode current collector aluminum foil, drying at 85 ℃, then carrying out cold pressing, trimming, cutting into pieces, slitting, and finally continuously drying for 4 hours at 85 ℃ under a vacuum condition to obtain a positive electrode piece. Specific kinds of the positive electrode active materials are shown in table 2.

(3) Preparation of negative pole piece

Mixing a negative electrode active material, a conductive agent Super P, a thickening agent carboxymethylcellulose sodium (CMC) and a binder styrene butadiene rubber emulsion (SBR) according to a mass ratio of 96.4:1.5:0.5:1.6, adding the mixture into solvent deionized water, and uniformly stirring under the action of a vacuum stirrer to obtain negative electrode slurry, wherein the solid content in the negative electrode slurry is 54 wt%; and uniformly coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil of a negative electrode current collector, drying at 85 ℃, then carrying out cold pressing, trimming, cutting and slitting, and finally continuously drying for 12 hours at 120 ℃ under a vacuum condition to obtain a negative electrode plate. Here, specific kinds of the anode active materials are shown in table 2.

(4) Preparation of electrolyte

The organic solvent is a mixed solution of Ethylene Carbonate (EC), Ethyl Methyl Carbonate (EMC) and diethyl carbonate (DEC), wherein the volume ratio of EC, EMC and DEC is 20:20: 60. And (3) dissolving the fully dried lithium salt in the organic solvent in an argon atmosphere glove box with the water content of less than 10ppm, then adding the additive, and uniformly mixing to obtain the electrolyte. Wherein the concentration of the lithium salt is 1 mol/L. Specific kinds of lithium salts used in the electrolyte and specific kinds and contents of additives in the electrolyte are shown in table 3. In table 3, the content of each additive is a mass percentage calculated based on the total mass of the electrolyte.

(5) Preparation of the separator

A polyethylene film (PE) having a thickness of 14 μm was used as a separator.

(6) Preparation of lithium ion battery

The positive pole piece, the isolation film and the negative pole piece are sequentially stacked, the isolation film is positioned between the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece to play a role of isolation, then the positive pole piece, the isolation film and the negative pole piece are wound into a square naked electric core, a tab is welded, the naked electric core is arranged in a packaging foil aluminum plastic film, then the naked electric core is baked at 80 ℃ to remove water, electrolyte is injected and sealed, and then the finished product of the soft package lithium ion battery is obtained through the processes of standing, hot cold pressing, formation (0.02C constant current charging to 3.3V, 0.1C constant current charging to 3.6V), shaping, capacity testing and the like, wherein the thickness of the finished product of the soft package lithium ion battery is 4.0mm, the width of.

In an embodiment of the present invention, the matrix of the cathode active material is in the form of secondary particles formed by agglomeration of primary particles, and the metal N oxide nanoparticles may be attached to the surfaces of the primary particles constituting the outermost layer of the matrix in the form of secondary particles and at least a part of the inner primary particles by directly performing the first coating treatment while water-washing the matrix. And a substance with a lower melting point is selected during the second coating, so that the first coating layer formed by the metal N oxide nano particles can be firmly combined with the substrate in the heat treatment process, and meanwhile, a layer of compact and continuous second coating layer in a layered form can be formed on the surfaces of the primary particles forming the outermost layer of the substrate in the form of secondary particles and at least one part of the primary particles in the inner part, so that the direct contact between the substrate and the electrolyte is effectively avoided, the surface roughness of the positive active material can be effectively reduced, the specific surface area of the positive active material is reduced, and the surface structure stability of the positive active material is improved. Therefore, the anode active material can reduce the effective contact area between the surface of the anode active material and the electrolyte, reduce the side reaction between the surface of the anode active material and the electrolyte and reduce the gas production of the lithium ion battery.

As can be seen from fig. 1 to 3, the matrix of the positive electrode active material is in the form of secondary particles formed by agglomeration of primary particles, the first coating layer formed of metal N oxide nanoparticles is coated on the surface of the primary particles of the matrix (white dotted matter in fig. 1) to function like a "nano pin", and a portion of the metal N oxide nanoparticles located at the contact position between the primary particles and the primary particles also function to bond the primary particles and the primary particles, and in fig. 1 and 2, an almost transparent continuous film layer is visible on the surface of the primary particles constituting the outermost layer of the matrix in the form of agglomerated secondary particles.

In addition, when the cyclic sultone compound and the lithium difluorobis (oxalate) phosphate and/or the lithium tetrafluorooxalate phosphate are added into the electrolyte of the embodiment of the invention at the same time, the cyclic sultone compound is oxidized and decomposed on the surface of the positive electrode to form a protective film, the oxidative decomposition of the electrolyte on the surface of the positive electrode is effectively reduced, the gas production of the lithium ion battery is further reduced, meanwhile, the oxalate functional group in the structure of the lithium difluorobis (oxalate) phosphate and/or the lithium tetrafluorooxalate phosphate enables the lithium difluorobis (oxalate) phosphate and/or the lithium tetrafluorooxalate phosphate to be easily oxidized on the surface of the positive electrode to generate an inorganic lithium salt containing characteristic elements such as P, F and the like, the protective film on the surface of the positive electrode is modified, and the P element in the inorganic lithium salt can be combined with lone pair electrons on oxygen in the positive electrode active material due to the vacancy orbit, the oxidation activity of the positive, therefore, the increase of direct current internal resistance in the circulation and storage processes of the lithium ion battery can be obviously inhibited, and the power performance of the lithium ion battery is improved. In addition, the surface of the matrix of the positive active material contains the double-layer coating layer, and the surface structure stability of the positive active material is higher, so that the oxidation activity of the positive active material on the cyclic sultone compound is further reduced, the increase of the interface impedance of the positive electrode can be inhibited to a certain extent, and the power performance of the lithium ion battery is improved.

Comparative examples 1 to 4 all used a common commercially available lithium nickel cobalt manganese ternary material LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2. Wherein, the cyclic sultone compound is not added in the comparative example 1, and the difluoro bis (oxalato) lithium phosphate or the tetrafluoro oxalato lithium phosphate are not added, so that the high-temperature storage volume expansion rate of the lithium ion battery is larger; compared with the prior art, only the cyclic sultone compound is added in the comparative example 2, the high-temperature storage volume expansion rate of the lithium ion battery can be greatly improved, but the direct current internal resistance increase rate of the lithium ion battery in the high-temperature circulation and storage processes is also high, so that the actual use requirement of the lithium ion battery is difficult to meet; in the comparative example 3, only lithium difluorobis (oxalato) phosphate is added, so that the high-temperature storage volume expansion rate of the lithium ion battery can be improved to a certain extent, but the improvement degree is weak, and the actual use requirement is difficult to meet; in comparative example 4, although the cyclic sultone compound and lithium difluorobis (oxalato) phosphate are added at the same time, the high-temperature storage volume expansion rate of the lithium ion battery is still higher due to the use of the commercial lithium nickel cobalt manganese ternary material, the larger specific surface area, the higher surface residual lithium content and the lower surface structure stability, and the actual use requirement of the lithium ion battery is still difficult to meet.

In comparative examples 5 to 7, although the cyclic sultone compound and lithium difluorobis (oxalato) phosphate were added at the same time, the matrix surface of the positive active material still had a large specific surface area due to only one coating layer, which did not reduce the contact between the surface of the positive active material and the electrolyte, and the high-temperature storage volume expansion rate of the lithium ion battery was still high, which still failed to meet the actual use requirements of the lithium ion battery.
